prompt:
Create a production full-body 2D game character source sheet for Waltraud Wartemarke, an elderly German waiting-line oracle in Grand Theft Amt, in a mature Disco Elysium meets Berlin painted style. This is a redesign, not an enlargement of the toy source.
REFERENCE ROLES: first image is Waltraud's identity/outfit/prop-hand reference ONLY; replace its chibi proportions and glossy cartoon finish completely. Second image is an accepted different adult character for grown-up body proportions and source-sheet framing ONLY; do not borrow her face, braid, skirt outfit or basket.
CHARACTER LOCK: stocky elderly woman about70, stern tired asymmetrical face, natural small eyes under pronounced grey brows, wrinkles, heavy lower cheeks, pale worn skin; silver-grey hair swept into a compact low bun. Plum/wine tailored wool coat with lapels, three brown buttons, two plain low pockets, rear waist half-belt with two buttons; cream ribbed high-neck jumper; charcoal straight trousers; complete dark-brown low-heeled lace walking shoes. ONE burgundy/red hard-backed tabbed folder held vertically against her LEFT ribs by her anatomical LEFT hand; exactly three small cream/yellow paper tabs at folder top. Anatomical RIGHT arm relaxed beside body, empty RIGHT hand. No additional bag, pen, glasses, jewelry or printed writing. Folder stays LEFT in every direction, naturally occluded in strict RIGHT profile, visible on her near side in LEFT profile.
COMPOSITION: four distinct original full-body neutral paintings on ONE horizontal row, left-to-right FRONT facing viewer, strict RIGHT-facing profile, BACK facing away, strict LEFT-facing profile. The back view must be the actual back of her head/bun/coat and heels. All four depict exactly the same person with identical adult density, stance, head-to-body scale, coat hem, clothes and grounded soles. Mature natural roughly6.5-to7-head body; coherent long connected torso, arms, thighs and shins, believable hands and whole shoes. Modest gap between complete feet. Coat hem around mid-thigh, not covering knees. Standing upright, arms relaxed; no gestures or walking action. No per-view foreshortened or smaller bodies. Entire head-to-sole included with generous transparent gutters around each figure, no ground shadow.
ART: angular expressive facial and fabric planes, broad visible dry-brush strokes, muted wine, dirty ochre skin lights, cool grey-green shadows; worn adult character painting with readable folds and shoe laces, not photographic, not 3D render, not smooth rounded/chibi, not fine noise over old toy shapes. Broad readable closed lip crease below nose, natural lip corners and lower-lip/chin paint for future speech; no open black mouth or exposed teeth. Each profile is a genuine independently painted opposing view, not mirrored pixels.
OUTPUT: wide landscape transparent-background RGBA PNG, four separated complete figures only, no labels, no grid, no scenery, no painted background, no checkerboard pattern. Preserve true transparent alpha.
